scientific_integrity: The one-factor triangular-graph classification is acknowledged as known and not claimed to be an independent discovery. Computations do not certify infinite statements. Literature-source access is differentiated by material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: First-order equality-and-unlabelled-adjacency logic at quantifier rank at most three; no counting, edge labels, higher ranks, or arbitrary graph products. The infinite theorem rests on a combinatorial proof; finite programs corroborate. Historical priority not exhaustive; a closely related coding paper was only accessible as an abstract.
title: Nine rank-three theories of line graphs of Hamming products
